title: Taming the Fragility of KV Cache Eviction in LLM Inference
one_line_claim: A defensive aggregation strategy for KV cache eviction that mitigates worst-case performance degradation by estimating and correcting for mean-aggregation failure modes.
method_summary: DefensiveKV estimates worst-case risk by computing a defensive score that accounts for token importance variance and prior-risk distribution. It then applies adaptive prior-risk correction to reweight importance scores, stabilizing mean aggregation against outlier tokens that cause quality collapse.

key_findings.quote: We observe that mean-pooled importance can be unexpectedly fragile: a single outlier token can devastate performance, despite the average importance being preserved.
key_findings.finding: Mean aggregation for KV cache eviction exhibits fragility: single high-variance tokens can cause severe quality loss despite averaging preserving global importance.

key_findings.quote: DefensiveKV reduces quality loss by 2.3x to 4.3x at 20% cache size
key_findings.finding: DefensiveKV reduces quality loss at 20% cache size by 2.3x to 4.3x across multiple benchmarks.

key_findings.quote: DefensiveKV is orthogonal to the choice of base importance estimator and requires no model retraining
key_findings.finding: The method generalizes across different token importance estimation approaches without requiring retraining.

relation_to_herald.shared: Both address catastrophic quality degradation induced by KV-cache compression in LLM generation. Both focus on worst-case failure modes rather than average-case performance. Both operate at inference time without requiring model retraining.
differs_on: DefensiveKV proposes a defensive aggregation strategy to mitigate eviction failures; HERALD predicts catastrophic failures via per-token logit features and XGBoost.
DefensiveKV targets mean-aggregation vulnerability in token selection; HERALD detects looping and non-termination from logit distribution signals.
DefensiveKV intervenes at the eviction strategy layer; HERALD intervenes by pre-onset prediction enabling downstream handlers.
